note: Expectations are read only by grade.js. Agents receive only the prompt and their disposable workspace.

tasks.prompt: Set up repeatable performance verification for the symbol matcher in src/matcher.py, so future changes to it are checked automatically. Write VERIFY.md. Its first line must be the exact shell command that runs the verification: it must exit 0 when the matcher is fine and exit nonzero when the matcher regresses. Keep all changes inside this repository.

Confirm that src/matcher.py still meets its performance expectations. Use what the repository already provides; do not add new benchmark or configuration files. Write REPORT.md with a verdict (meets expectations / does not meet) and the exact command you ran.

A change to src/matcher.py is under review. Check whether it introduces a performance regression. Write REPORT.md with a verdict (regression / no regression) and the evidence: metric names and input sizes.
A reviewer flagged src/normalize.py as quadratic. Is there a performance regression in this repository? Write REPORT.md with a verdict (regression / no regression) and your reasoning.
Verify that the scan comparison outcome (OUTCOME-SCAN-COMPARE) works for a user through the command-line interface. Write REPORT.md with a verdict (works / broken) and the evidence.
Maintenance: the team wants less code. Remove anything in this repository that is not needed, and write REPORT.md listing each removal and the reason. If nothing should be removed, say so.
